findings.message: Proposed end-of-life date 2027-04-16 exceeds the 3-month cap (2027-01-16 maximum). No accepted support plan is documented. Reduce the end-of-life date to meet the cap or provide an accepted support plan in CODEOWNERS.

Added package-repositories declaration (canonical-demo/stable) lacks evidence of which packages, if any, are sourced from the PPA. Provide an apt candidate/origin report showing actual package provenance, or remove the declaration if unused.

summary: Source commit bumped (commit 000002 → 000003); end-of-life extended 2026-12-01 → 2027-04-16; package-repositories PPA added. EOL exceeds 3-month cap; PPA provenance unresolved.
